verdict.rationale: Coinbase Payments (CDP) is not itself an AI agent product but a payments/wallet platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair capability question, and the evidence shows exactly that: the CDP CLI includes a built-in MCP server (`cdp mcp`) exposing every API endpoint as a tool, plus the Coinbase Wallet MCP that connects any AI assistant to a wallet for balance checks, sends, swaps, and x402 payments. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and more detail on MCP server auth/setup specifics.
